/narrative.1: The overall goal of the programme is to increase the incomes of poor rural households that depend substantially on the production and trade of dairy products for their livelihoods. The programme has two purposes: (a) increasing the financial returns of market-oriented production and trade activities by small operators, through improved information on market opportunities, raised productivity, cost reduction, value adding, and more reliable trade relations; and (b) the generation of self-employment and other income opportunities for rural households by the market-oriented dairy activities resulting from strengthened farmer organizations. The programme will work with the Government to enhance the environment for market-driven private-sector development of the dairy industry, and with groups of smallholder dairy producers and traders to strengthen their capacity to respond to market opportunities.
